method: Viewed all four rendered contact sheets covering every assigned page. Rendered the coverage table, two dense month tables, a dense mathematical catalog table and a sparse month-ending page at up to 1600 pixels for closer inspection. This was a read-only visual review; no source, builder or PDF was edited.

findings.description: This is a short March-ending continuation page containing the final Further development paragraph and source receipt before April starts on page 43. It leaves substantial whitespace, but is neither blank nor clipped and contains no overlap.
findings.action: No change required for release; pagination could be tightened in a later cosmetic revision if desired.

checks.clipped_text: No visible clipping in the assigned contact sheets or enlarged table spot checks.
checks.table_overlap: No visible overlap; cell text wraps within its columns and row boundaries. Dense tables on pages 10, 45 and 97 were enlarged and inspected.
checks.blank_pages: No unintended blank page in pages 1–120. January source-gap page is intentionally brief; page 42 is a legitimate short continuation.
checks.major_layout: No major layout defect observed. Titles, section blocks, margins and footer page numbers remain consistently separated.
checks.glyphs: No obvious missing-glyph box or damaged formula rendering was observed in the enlarged spot checks.

limits: Contact-sheet inspection covers the layout of all 120 pages, with detailed reading limited to the stated enlarged pages. This review does not re-prove mathematics or certify every individual glyph in the whole document.
